optimizedDescription.value: Report provider-computed blast radius for files, logical symbols, specs, or public exports with deterministic exact selection.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Impact

## Rules

- Signature: `specd graph impact [--file <paths...> | --symbol <reference> | --spec <id> | --export <public-name> --from <file-or-surface>] [--direction dependents|dependencies|upstream|downstream|both] [--depth <n>] [--config <path> | --path <path>] [--format text|json|toon]`.
- Require exactly 1 target family. `--export` + `--from` required together; missing half fails before provider open. `--config` + `--path` mutually exclusive.
- Normalize `dependents`→`upstream`, `dependencies`→`downstream`; default `upstream`; default depth `3`. CLI delegates all target resolution, traversal, risk, and aggregation to `CodeGraphProvider` via `withProvider`.
- `--symbol`: canonical logical-symbol impact. Unqualified selectors prefer unique case-exact name; ambiguous case-exact returns bounded deterministic candidates without traversal; only absent case-exact permits case-insensitive exact-name. Reject prefix, component, textual matches. Preserve qualified/full occurrence exact semantics.
- `--file`: resolve canonical graph files through `cli:graph-cli-context`; unresolved or ambiguous unprefixed paths fail. Single/multi-file provider aggregation includes changed symbols, affected files/symbols, counts, risk, covering specs.
- `--spec`: `getSpec(specId)` then `analyzeSpecImpact`; missing node throws `SpecNotFoundError`, exit 1, `SPEC_NOT_FOUND`. Include `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL` reachability.
- `--export`: select exact public binding through provider lookup after conservative resolution, never capped/ranked search. Render binding, canonical logical target, ordered binding chain; separate exact-binding consumers from complete canonical-symbol impact. Ambiguity returns deterministic candidates; never merge/select.
- Validate availability/staleness exactly once after provider open. `GRAPH_BUSY`, `GRAPH_PROVIDER_STALE`, or open failure use infrastructure path, exit 3. No per-target/result availability checks.
- Display paths: pure projection from project/workspace configuration; no graph reads. Multi-file output renders affected file once per contributing input. Formatting must avoid per-file/symbol store fan-out and `StoreOverloadError`.
- Text: target/depth, risk, aggregate counts, changed symbols, affected files with `name:line (d=N)`, per-symbol/file breakdown. Explain counts as dependents for upstream and dependencies for downstream. Multiple matched symbols render sequential analyses.
- File covering specs: render provider result only. Text groups depth-0 evidence as direct target coverage; minimum depth >0 as blast-radius coverage. Mixed spec appears once in direct group. JSON/TOON preserve ordered `coveringSpecs` and all `{ kind, target, depth }`; retain file coverage without symbol coverage and graph-health warnings.
- JSON/TOON emit full result unchanged, `AffectedSymbol.depth`, and `riskLevel`, `directDepsCount`, `indirectDepsCount`, `transitiveDepsCount`, `affectedFilesCount`. All paths project-relative.

## Constraints

- Platform symbols and lifecycle helpers come from `@specd/sdk`; CLI owns display/path formatting only.
- CLI MUST NOT implement symbol/export resolution, impact traversal, risk, coverage derivation, or multi-file aggregation.
- Call `process.exit(0)` explicitly after provider closes.
